en.why_it_matters: The room is part of the music here: Ravi brings his father’s centennial project into the Village Vanguard, where John Coltrane’s 1961 performances became part of the core recorded history of modern jazz. Two different personnel configurations across the week make the residency a living argument about lineage rather than a museum-piece tribute.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is viable in mid-October, actively make room for one of these nights and let the Village Vanguard anchor the evening. Six dates provide enough flexibility to choose the best fit within a broader New York trip.

The title reconnects directly to Hersch's 2004 Trio + 2 project: contemporary reviews document Malaby, Alessi and Gress in that original quintet concept and note a six-night Village Vanguard residency around the album's release. en.why_it_matters: This is not just Hersch adding two horns to a trio: Malaby, Alessi and Gress reconnect the 2026 band to the actual Trio + 2 language Hersch developed in 2004, while Joe Dyson changes the rhythmic engine. Bringing that concept back for another Vanguard week turns the booking into a live comparison across more than two decades of ensemble history.
en.trip_verdict: If New York works in late October, actively make room for one of the six nights. The week-long run makes it easy to choose the best date and pair the Vanguard with another New York reason rather than forcing a single-night turnaround.

es.why_it_matters: No se trata sólo de agregar dos metales a un trío: Malaby, Alessi y Gress conectan la formación de 2026 con el lenguaje real de Trio + 2 que Hersch desarrolló en 2004, mientras Joe Dyson cambia el motor rítmico. Volver con ese concepto durante otra semana en el Vanguard permite escuchar, en vivo, más de dos décadas de historia del ensamble.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York funciona a finales de octubre, sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las seis noches. La residencia permite escoger la fecha que mejor acomode y combinar el Vanguard con otra razón para estar en la ciudad, sin forzar un viaje relámpago por una sola función.
